units.source_text: 柏木首先吹奏了《源氏车》小曲，我震惊于他的娴熟技巧。

en.t: Kashiwagi first played the short piece Genji-guruma, and I was astonished by his skillful technique.

units.source_text: 我模仿他将嘴贴在吹孔上，却吹不出声音来。

en.t: I imitated him and pressed my mouth to the blowing hole, but I could not make a sound.

units.source_text: 他教我先用左手握住尺八上方，然后将下巴颜地压下，然后他仔细地教我如何张开贴在吹孔上的嘴，如何将大薄片似的风送进吹孔里等等诀窍。

en.t: He taught me first to hold the upper part of the shakuhachi with my left hand, then to press my chin firmly downward, and then carefully showed me the tricks: how to open the mouth pressed against the blowing hole, how to send in a broad, thin sheet of breath, and so on.

units.source_text: 我多次试吹，还是吹不出声音来。

en.t: I tried blowing many times, but still could not produce a sound.

units.source_text: 我的脸颊、我的眼睛都使上了劲儿。

en.t: My cheeks and even my eyes were straining with effort.

units.source_text: 尽管没有风，可我觉得他中的月亮都粉碎了。

en.t: Although no breath came out, I felt as if the moon inside him had been shattered to pieces.
